disambiguation: Despite its name, it is not limited to MinerU; it supports seven parsing backends.
extras: Desktop-only (spawns local CLI processes and bundles an unzip library); MinerU cloud offers a free no-token mode and a paid Precision API; local backends need a Python CLI; README continues in Chinese.
problem: Obsidian cannot turn PDFs, Office files, or images into editable Markdown notes on its own.

relations.evidence: MinerU (cloud) — free mode (no token) or the Precision API (with a token, extracts image attachments).
markitdown (local) — runs the local Python CLI; desktop only; no images.
docling (local) — runs the local Python CLI; desktop only; Markdown only.
Doc2X (document parsing) — Doc2X, strong on PDF formulas / tables / layout.
TextIn (document parsing) — TextIn xParse for PDF / image / Office.
Baidu OCR (document parsing) — Baidu Cloud document parsing for PDF / image / Office

summary: Right-click parser that converts PDFs, Office files, and images into Markdown via seven backends, saving notes and image attachments to configured folders.
